# Palm Beach Rental Pros

> Luxury residential rentals in Palm Beach County with Paul Schafranick — waterfront estates, gated communities, and high-rise living.

Palm Beach Rental Pros is a boutique luxury rental consultancy led by Paul Schafranick. We help renters find luxury rentals in Palm Beach County, including Boca Raton, Delray Beach, West Palm Beach, Palm Beach, Jupiter, and Boynton Beach. Contact: 561-255-7285.
